headline: October PCE and Q3 GDP land this morning with a December Fed hike nearly fully priced, an AI-led tech selloff resuming and Hormuz attacks still disrupting oil flows.
rates: The 10-year yield was about 4.86% this morning (4.92% at Tuesday's close) and CME pricing puts a quarter-point December hike above 97%.
fed: Minutes released Nov 18 showed nearly all officials expecting a December hike, with the Dec 8-9 FOMC meeting next and Governor Waller arguing for a half point.
oil: Oil slipped this morning (Brent roughly $88-91 across sources) as expected global surplus outweighed supply risk from Hormuz tanker strikes and Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities, with OPEC+ meeting Nov 29.
geo: The Iran conflict keeps Hormuz traffic far below pre-war levels, and the WSJ reports the US is preparing higher tariffs on China, the EU and others.
